risks.risk: Exact TV size (86 inches) may be wrong; price depends heavily on size.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the TV’s back label/spec sticker showing screen size and model number (or a tape-measure shot across the screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/unknown-size LG smart TV (worst case vs the claimed 86 inches).

risks.risk: Model number may be different (LG 86UA85006LA not confirmed), affecting value and parts availability.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the model number on the rear label and the TV’s side/stand label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic LG smart TV without the claimed premium model.

risks.risk: Seller’s “Samsung” statement conflicts with the LG/webOS evidence; could indicate mixed-up listing or wrong item.
risks.proof: Ask the seller to confirm brand and send a photo of the LG logo/label on the TV frame or rear panel.
risks.if_unproven: Treat as potentially mismatched/uncertain item and price at the lower end of the matching comparables.

risks.risk: Functional condition (panel health, backlight, lines, dead pixels) is not fully testable from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing: (1) full-screen solid colors (red/green/blue/white/black), (2) scrolling text, (3) brightness test, and (4) HDMI input test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst case: assume faults until proven).

risks.risk: Accessories/inputs may be missing (remote, power cable, wall mount, soundbar/box).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything included laid out (remote, cables, any external box).
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV only (no remote/cables assumed).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the rear label showing brand, exact model number, and screen size.
Send a short video test: solid color screens + HDMI input + no lines/banding/dead pixels.
Confirm what is included: remote, power cable, any external box/soundbar, and whether it supports Wi‑Fi without extra devices.
Resolve the brand conflict: provide a photo showing LG branding on the TV frame/rear label.
